name: frontend-secret-scanner
description: Browser-side scanner that finds secrets in text before that text is sent to a server or a model.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e 'import{readFileSync,writeFileSync,readdirSync}from"node:fs";const q=String.fromCharCode(34),s=String.fromCharCode(39);for(const n of readdirSync("dist")){if(!n.endsWith(".d.ts"))continue;const p="dist/"+n;writeFileSync(p,readFileSync(p,"utf8").split("\n").map(line=>line.includes(" from ")?line.replaceAll(".ts"+q,".js"+q).replaceAll(".ts"+s,".js"+s):line).join("\n"))}'
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
